tools.name: aiagent.get_context
tools.description: Describe the current AI Agent page, signed-in state, workspace context, and the app surfaces available for navigation.

tools.name: aiagent.navigate
tools.description: Navigate to an AI Agent surface. Workspace surfaces use the current workspace unless a workspace slug or id is supplied. Navigation never bypasses normal authentication, onboarding, billing, or Labs visibility gates.

workspace.description: Optional workspace slug or id. Only needed when navigating to a workspace surface from outside a workspace.
